surface_mechanism_description: A combustion reaction between O atoms provided by a dissociative chemisorption of O2 molecules and precursor ligands was considered as a main route for making the Ru metal.
evidence: We consider that a combustion reaction between O atoms provided by a dissociative chemisorption of O2 molecules and precursor ligands would be a main route for making the Ru metal, which was reported in the study of Altonen et al. using Ru(II)Cp2 though we did not perform the mechanism study on the surface reaction.
